text:
maria: FYI compliance pinged about customers wanting a clear 'who changed what' export that's safe to hand to auditors. They asked: can we annotate change events with an "entitlement_hint" so console can show why a user could see/download it? Also they want downloads gated for privileged changes.

sam: +1 on the hint field. Keep it advisory (string) not an access check. e.g. "entitlement_hint": "tenant-admin, infra-owner" so the UI can surface it.

jen: we need to be careful about PII in exports. If we're enabling downloads we should default to redaction mode for user identifiers unless the requester has a justification.

li: telemetry/quotas note: downloads could be huge (full change-trail). We should emit an event for export_requested and export_completed with size_bytes so we can throttle/alert. Also rate-limit by tenant and agent.

ada: UX idea: when a user hits "Download change trail" for sensitive routes show a modal: "This export contains privileged changes. Provide justification to proceed." Provide a short freeform justification field and show who will be recorded as approver.

maria: sounds reasonable. question: do we require a manager approval flow, or just capture the justification and keep an audit trail? compliance said prefer captured justification stored for 90 days and visible to security. approvals optional.

sec-bot: Policy check: for privileged actor changes (role assignment, RBAC edits, routing-policy toggle) require 2 factors: 1) RBAC check at request time; 2) persist justification and requestor identity in the export metadata. Retention = 365 days per Legal for high-risk tenants.

ops-bot: Implementation sketch: reuse presigned-export service, add entitlement_hint to event shape, and a gated download endpoint. Example export envelope:

```json
{
  "export_id": "exp_01F...",
  "tenant_id": "t-123",
  "requested_by": "maria",
  "requested_at": "2024-06-15T18:12:00Z",
  "justification": "Audit for vendor review",
  "entitlement_hint": "tenant-admin,security-review",
  "filter": "route:billing/*",
  "presigned_url": "https://redwood-s3/presigned",
  "size_bytes": 1256423
}
```

sam: that looks good. For the event schema let's add a small enum tag for sensitivity: LOW|MEDIUM|PRIVILEGED so UI can color-code and default redaction.

jen: also surface a preview mode (first N events) inline so auditors can confirm before a full download. saves cost.

li: re quotas: large exports should consume export_quota_units. If customers hit a quota we fallback to a streaming SLA-only export (no presigned link) or a scheduled export to S3 with owner notification.

ada: UX follow-ups: - modal copy - who can see stored justification - link to appeal / request manager approval. I'll draft mocks.

maria: decisions: 1) add entitlement_hint (string) + sensitivity enum to export envelope, 2) require justification for privileged exports and persist it, 3) telemetry events for request/completion (size_bytes), 4) preview-first UX + modal, 5) quota accounting and fallback path.

maria: action items: @sam implement schema change and presigned gating (owner: sam, due EoW), @li add telemetry & quota counters (owner: li, due next Wed), @ada mock modal and preview UX (owner: ada, due Tue), @jen design redaction defaults and docs (owner: jen, due Thu).

sam: assigning now. I'll open a PR with schema + migration notes.

jen: I'll start redaction matrix doc and examples for SOC/ auditors.

li: will add metrics + a dashboard card for export volume by tenant and avg size.

maria: thanks all. tagging this as compliance sprint item. if anything urgent ping me in #incidents. :thumbsup:
